reason: My guests find me on Google Maps, they look at the reviews and photos and they walk in or call. A website in six languages with a WhatsApp button doesn't put more people at my tables than that Maps listing already does.
objection: Nobody searching 'restaurant Omiš' clicks through to a website. They read the reviews on Maps and come. I'd be paying for something guests never open.
would_change_my_mind: If you could show me that a restaurant like mine moved up on Google Maps and got more guests because of your profile work and the website, with real numbers from someone on this coast I can call.
